title: Canonical structure, relationship ownership and authority regressions

scenarios: Derived workload, evaluation coverage and approval
Unbound executable files, paths and customization metadata
Candidate, plan, operation and target binding
Expired, revoked, denied and missing authority
Synthetic safe refusal and admission without external effects
spec.passCriteria: All npm run check assertions pass; base comparison passes for the chosen base; dependency audit reports no moderate-or-higher vulnerabilities
spec.procedure: Run npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm run check, npm run validate -- --base <full-sha>, and npm audit --audit-level=moderate as separate commands. Record actual subject revision or exact diff/content hash and output. CI runs the same gates.
